title: Insulation Rebates in Maple Ridge 2026: Up to $5,500 from BC Hydro
desc: Four in five Maple Ridge households own their home, and 5,160 own a house built before 1981. BC Hydro's insulation formula, eligibility rules and a worked example.
lead: Maple Ridge has one of the highest ownership rates in Metro Vancouver and a lot of detached houses. That makes it a good fit for the BC Hydro insulation rebate, which is built for owned houses.
cards_heading: What BC Hydro pays for insulation in Maple Ridge
cards_intro: We re-read BC Hydro's insulation page on October 2, 2026. The rebate is for homes heated mainly by electricity. FortisBC pays the same formula to its gas customers.

cards.title: Attic
cards.amount: $0.02 x R added x sq ft
cards.note: Capped at $900, at least R12 added.

cards.title: Walls and basement
cards.amount: $0.09 x R added x sq ft
cards.note: Capped at $1,200 for each of wall cavity, wall sheathing and basement or crawlspace.

cards.title: Floors and other spots
cards.amount: $0.07 x R added x sq ft
cards.note: Capped at $1,000 for exposed floors and headers, at least R20 added.

cards.title: More than one upgrade
cards.note: For completing more than one eligible upgrade.

after_cards:
An older house on a larger lot

A 1,600 square foot attic at R-14 brought to R-50 adds R-36. The attic formula gives 0.02 x 36 x 1,600 = $1,152, so the $900 cap applies. Adding R-12 to 1,000 square feet of exterior wall pays 0.09 x 12 x 1,000 = $1,080. Total: $1,980 by our arithmetic.
sections: The 2021 Census counted 33,110 households in Maple Ridge. About 79% own their home and only 17% live in apartments. That is the highest ownership share in our BC list apart from the Township of Langley. Of the households, 9,480 (29%) live in homes built before 1981, and 5,160 are owner-occupied single-detached houses from that time. With 53% of households in single-detached houses, there is a lot of attic and wall space the rebate can reach.

Parts of Maple Ridge are rural. The program covers the house but not garages, shops or outbuildings. A detached house with a secondary suite can qualify if each is separately metered. Homes that BC defines as substantially reconstructed under the Homeowner Protection Act are excluded, which can matter after a major rebuild.

The average January low from 2015 to 2024 was 0.1°C and the coldest day was -19.6°C. That is a deeper low than Surrey or Burnaby, because Maple Ridge sits farther inland near the mountains. A cold night can sink well below freezing while the average stays mild, so a good attic matters on those nights.

BC Hydro accepts batts, loose fill, board and spray foam. For a Maple Ridge house with an open attic, loose fill is the usual way to add depth over what is already there. Closed wall cavities in an older house are often filled by blowing material in through small holes. Spray foam and rigid board suit basement walls and rim joists. Each type carries a different R-value per inch, so compare quotes by finished R-value, not by thickness.

The rebate cannot be more than the invoice shows you paid, so a cheap job with a high formula result is paid at cost.
If your household income is lower

BC Hydro tells income-qualified customers to apply to the CleanBC Better Homes Energy Savings Program instead of this one, and the two cannot be combined. We checked the 2026 Energy Savings Program document and it lists heat pumps, water heaters, ventilation and electrical upgrades, but no insulation or window rebates. The no-cost Energy Conservation Assistance Program may still include insulation, so ask there first.

• Heating must be mainly electric and able to heat at least half the home to 22°C.
  • The contractor must be in the Home Performance Contractor Network.
  • Fix pest or moisture problems first.
  • Apply within six months of the invoice date.

We did not find Maple Ridge insulation companies in our Google review data, so use BC Hydro's contractor search to find current members.
claim_heading: How to claim in Maple Ridge
claim_steps: Confirm the house is at least 12 months old and mainly electric-heated.
Ask for quotes listing the R-value added and area for each space.
Combine with a second upgrade if you can, to check the bonus.
faq: Can I claim for a detached house with a rental suite?
Yes, if the house and the suite are separately metered.
Does a workshop or shed qualify?
No. Garages, workshops and outbuildings are not eligible.
How cold does Maple Ridge get?
The average January low was 0.1°C and the coldest day in 2015 to 2024 was -19.6°C.
Is there a limit on the attic rebate?
Yes. It is capped at $900, and the new layer must add at least R12.
Is there a free option for lower incomes?
Yes. Income-qualified customers can apply for free evaluations and upgrades.
